title: lygodium forsteri
intro: Lygodium forsteri, commonly known as the fern lyre, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lygodiaceae. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lygodium forsteri include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating infections. The bioactive constituents present in Lygodium forsteri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
